messages:
irene: quick note: proposing a tight RBAC change for private/onprem: remove cluster-admin from 'deployer' and grant a narrow 'keystore-decrypt' role to the onprem agent. need sec+ops sign-off.
sam: paste minimal role so i can check token scopes and audit behavior.
irene: snippet I validated in sandbox:
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: keystore-decrypt
rules:
- apiGroups: ["kms.redwood.io"]
  resources: ["decryptrequests"]
  verbs: ["create"]
```
leo: two asks: ensure API audit policy records request.user and response.status for kms.decrypts; and confirm agent logs are forwarded to SIEM before we remove broad creds.
mira: netpol note: agent must only reach eproxy/HSM at 10.8.0.5:443 and local metrics. overly broad deny will break decrypts and risk fail-open.
irene: rollout: canary in eu-onprem, 24h observation, rollback by re-adding deployer cluster-admin + reverting netpols if decrypt errors spike.
sam: CVE check? recent CVE for agent?
leo: CVE-2026-1421 hits <1.3.2. patched in 1.3.3 and mitigated in backport. upgrade canary hosts first.
kms-bot: KMS audit forwarding: enabled for eu-onprem -> siem-internal.redwood.local:6514 (TLS). Verified 2026-03-10.
mira: add alert: decrypt_fail_rate >0.5% for 5m -> suspend rollout + notify #eng-oncall.
oncall-bot: alert created. playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/onprem-keystore-failures
sam: audit retention for eu-onprem KMS indexes? compliance needs 1y.
leo: retention = 13 months; extension workflow available.
irene: i'll open a PR with the role + netpol and schedule canary 09:00 UTC tomorrow. tagging @sam @leo @mira for approvals. :thumbsup:
sam: approving, will run smoke tests.
leo: approving from sec; note CVE fix.
mira: approving for netpols; will coordinate conntrack/tuning.
irene: will include rollback commands and checklist in PR.
